summary: Updated implementation plan to reflect the successful expansion of the University of Bisha 3D digital twin masterplan: expanded to a vast, wide 2400m x 2400m open campus layout, integrated all user-specified buildings and areas from specifying_everything__47ad10c3.png (University Central Library, Football Ground, Spectator Grandstand, Buildings 1 to 11, Shaded Car Parking Area, Small Playgrounds, Mosque, and full outer perimeter ring roads), and updated the floating Satellite Radar and expanded 2D GIS modal with the user's annotated map as the primary layer underlay.
